title: Captain Phasma
description: Serving as one of the First Order's commanding triumvirate alongside General Hux and Kylo Ren, the responsibility of training the first Order Stormtroopers fell to the brutal hands of Captain Phasma. She worked ruthlessly to stamp out and traces of betrayal in her ranks, all from the comfort of her custom armor, crafted from salvaged chromium from a Naboo cruiser.
